forum.content_text:
Hi all,

I am trying to implement simple USB-FS communication on a BlueCoin board (STEVAL-BCNCS01V1). I am following [the official STM tutorial on USB CDC](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1sjU9iNvh_khDZHDM9Qau03PGKwMd4u7U/view) and referencing [the official SW package for BlueCoin](https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-bcnkt01.html).

So, for USB I need PLL source from HSE clock: BlueCoin [schematic](https://www.st.com/resource/en/schematic_pack/steval-bcnkt01v1_schematic.pdf) shows that there is a crystal oscillator @16Mhz (NDK NX2520SA) installed directly on the board, so I configured RCC HSE as Crystal/Ceramic Resonator; the problem is that the function *HAL\_RCC\_OscConfig(&RCC\_OscInitStruct)* in *SystemClock\_Config* retrieves HAL\_TIMEOUT as a result. Timeout value is default at 100ms.

Clock configuration in STM32CubeMX is as suggested in the official USB tutorial:

![ghibli_0-1776289461396.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/7259246b-8d22-6d9e-8575-905a42814711.png "ghibli_0-1776289461396.png")

My current debug configuration has BlueCoin connected via SWD to a NUCLEO-G0B1RE, as suggested in [UM2240](https://www.st.com/resource/en/user_manual/um2240-getting-started-with-the-stevalbcnkt01v1-bluecoin-kit-augmented-acoustics-and-motion-sensing-development-platform-stmicroelectronics.pdf) (see page 14).

Could you please help me? Am I missing something? Thanks to anybody who can help!
forum.author: ghibli

scraped_replies.html:
Hello @ghibli and welcome to the ST community, 

I don't have idea about that BlueCoin board but referring to its schematic, it has indeed a crystal on it of 16MHz:

But from what you shared in the CubeMx screenshot, it seems you are configuring HSE in Bypass mode:

Only one pin is used in this case while you need OSC_IN and OSC_OUT for a crystal.

So you need to select Crystal/Ceramic Resonator in CubeMx for your case:

Bypass mode is used for example for crystal oscilators (XO) and not for crystals (XTAL).

PS: in your main.c you've attached, HSE is correctly configured! So that doesn't reflect the CubeMX configuration! which induces to some confisions here.. 

 RCC_OscInitStruct.OscillatorType = RCC_OSCILLATORTYPE_HSE;
 RCC_OscInitStruct.HSEState = RCC_HSE_ON;
 RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLState = RCC_PLL_ON;
 RCC_OscInitStruct.PLL.PLLSource = RCC_PLLSOURCE_HSE;

Hope that helps.
